title: Raid on the Padre Street stable and leaving for Chicago
summary: After Joe's band was raided at a dance hall, he left New Orleans for Chicago, the Royal Garden, the Plantation, and then the riverboat trip with Louis.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Oh, yes. They got tips. And the tips was all made, put in a box. Yes. And it was each out of one to the other. Every man would get so much. Whenever they got, every man would get it. But then he played down there for a long, long time. And after he played down there, he had a little band playing at a stable, they call it, on Padre Street. Used to play around there. Well... At a stable? It was a dance hall. That they fixed up for the... For the... To dance. To dance, yes. To dance. And they raided them one night. Took Joe to the... Took Joe's band and everybody was in there. But Joe thought it was terrible. He said a man working for... Making an honest living to the raided man, take him to jail. And that's why he left New Orleans. He never came back. Then he went to Chicago. There was a lady running a dance hall on 35th Street. Thirty... Thirty-first. Thirty-first. Oh, yes. Thirty-first. That was the Royal... The Royal Garden played for Miss Major. A lady named Miss Major. And he went there and he played. He was quite a success there. So... He got a big job to play at the plantation. That was black and tan. It made it quite a success there. A beautiful review and everything there. But after a while and the probation come in... Everything... The beginning of the radio all around... Joe was out of work. But in the meantime... Joe got Louis... To have Miss Major. With him. With him. Louis promised him when he left you that he would come. If he got a good job. Yeah. He got a good job. Well, Louis was young then. He was very young. He used to run errand first. He'd come to my house then. But a boy... He'd come to my house and make errand first. And he followed Joe. Every step Joe went around. And Joe was fond of him. He was fond of Joe. And I used to always call him my boy. Mm-hm. Well... Louis got a job. Kendall and Joe got a job. So they went to St. Louis on the boat. The steamer...
Sidney I believe what their name was. Yes. It was one of the boats. I think the St. Paul sometime around there. Yes. Sidney though I believe was the main one they worked on first.
After he worked on this boat... Joe went to Chicago. He got this job. at this job. It was a fairly nice job it was made.
